title: MILO Marathon Bacolod Leg 2026 Review: The City of Smiles Qualifier
seo_title: MILO Marathon Bacolod Leg 2026 Review | Philippines Race
meta_description: National MILO Marathon 2026 Bacolod Leg: October 4. RUNRIO's premier series qualifier in the City of Smiles.
dek: Set for 4 October 2026 in Bacolod City, this RUNRIO-produced MILO Marathon qualifying leg brings the Philippines' premier running series to the 'City of Smiles.'
verdict: The MILO Marathon Bacolod Leg is a RUNRIO-produced qualifying round of the Philippines' premier running series in Bacolod City — the capital of Negros Occidental, known for its MassKara Festival, its chicken inasal, and its gentle, smiling culture. Five distances from 1K to 21K make it accessible across ages. RUNRIO's production ensures professional standards. October in Bacolod is the transition into the northeast monsoon. A solid MILO series qualifier in one of the country's most charming cities.
